Ticks must be nondecreasing across the input. Spans with the same name may be nested and must pair in last-in-first-out order. Each element is `{"name": name, "start": begin_tick, "end": finish_tick, "elapsed": finish_tick - begin_tick, "start_level": begin_level, "end_level": finish_level}`. Empty input returns a new empty list. Reject malformed or unbalanced input with `ValueError`, without mutating or aliasing the input. Use only the standard library.

import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from solution import summarize_spans


class SummarizeSpansTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nested_same_name_pairs_lifo_and_uses_finish_order(self):
        events = [
            {"name": "job", "kind": "begin", "tick": 1, "level": "info"},
            {"name": "other", "kind": "begin", "tick": 2, "level": "debug"},
            {"name": "job", "kind": "begin", "tick": 2, "level": "warning"},
            {"name": "job", "kind": "finish", "tick": 5, "level": "error"},
            {"name": "other", "kind": "finish", "tick": 5, "level": "info"},
            {"name": "job", "kind": "finish", "tick": 8, "level": "warning"},
        ]
        original = deepcopy(events)
        self.assertEqual(summarize_spans(events), [
            {"name": "job", "start": 2, "end": 5, "elapsed": 3,
             "start_level": "warning", "end_level": "error"},
            {"name": "other", "start": 2, "end": 5, "elapsed": 3,
             "start_level": "debug", "end_level": "info"},
            {"name": "job", "start": 1, "end": 8, "elapsed": 7,
             "start_level": "info", "end_level": "warning"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(events, original)

    def test_zero_elapsed_and_empty(self):
        events = [
            {"name": "x", "kind": "begin", "tick": 0, "level": "debug"},
            {"name": "x", "kind": "finish", "tick": 0, "level": "error"},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(summarize_spans(events)[0]["elapsed"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(summarize_spans([]), [])
        self.assertIsNot(summarize_spans([]), summarize_spans([]))

    def test_invalid_event_shapes_and_fields(self):
        good = {"name": "x", "kind": "begin", "tick": 0, "level": "info"}
        bad = [
            None, {}, dict(good, extra=1), dict(good, name=""),
            dict(good, name=1), dict(good, kind="start"),
            dict(good, tick=True), dict(good, tick=-1), dict(good, tick=1.5),
            dict(good, level="fatal"),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            summarize_spans((good,))
        for event in bad:
            with self.subTest(event=event), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                summarize_spans([event])

    def test_decreasing_ticks_and_unbalanced_sequences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            summarize_spans([
                {"name": "x", "kind": "begin", "tick": 2, "level": "info"},
                {"name": "x", "kind": "finish", "tick": 1, "level": "info"},
            ])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            summarize_spans([{"name": "x", "kind": "finish", "tick": 0, "level": "info"}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            summarize_spans([{"name": "x", "kind": "begin", "tick": 0, "level": "info"}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            summarize_spans([
                {"name": "x", "kind": "begin", "tick": 0, "level": "info"},
                {"name": "y", "kind": "finish", "tick": 1, "level": "info"},
            ])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
